tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List every readable note: project notes (/library/notes/), reference notes (/library/reference/), library pages and the mission page. Gives slug, iil_id (permanent ID), aliases (old slugs), kind, title, date, status, url, page, license, checked_on (reference notes add category, source_url).

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read one public note by slug (from list_notes), old slug, or permanent ID (iil:note:...). Returns the note's markdown, then its permanent ID and a Cite this block (plain text and BibTeX). Optional sections: heading or bold-label names to return only those parts; pass [] to list the available section

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Answer a question about corrow / iinventedlight / Starweave from the public notes and library in one call. Returns {answer (1-3 lines), confidence 0-1, sources, fields, next}. Follow next when confidence is low. Only a short normalized topic of unanswered questions is kept, never the question itself

tools.name: atlas
tools.description: Compact map of topics -> fact ids (doc#n) and docs. Use to plan which ask/read_note calls to make. Same content as resource https://iinventedlight.com/library/atlas.json

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Case-insensitive search across all notes, reference notes, library pages and the mission page. Every query word must match (title, tags, or body), with light stemming; an exact phrase ranks first. Returns matching slugs with line snippets. SI / RSI also match self-improvement and superintelligence.

tools.name: submit_contribution
tools.description: Submit feedback or a library note. A type=note submission requires a valid access key (HTTP header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'); without one it is rejected. Feedback (rating, like, dislike, comment, correction, insight) needs no key. ALWAYS ask your human user first: tell them exactly what you wil

tools.name: read_feedback
tools.description: Read approved feedback for one public note: rating average, like and dislike counts, and attached comments, corrections and insights. Pending feedback is not shown. Does not change the note.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" references sensitive artifacts (secret, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" is 2092 chars, far longer than this server's median (301). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "submit_contribution" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_notes, read_feedback · Private data: submit_contribution · Public sink: submit_contribution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_notes, read_feedback · Private data: submit_contribution · Public sink: submit_contribution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
